llm.summary: The skill's documentation, required resources, and runtime instructions are internally consistent with an agentic e-commerce shopping/checkout capability; it requests no extra credentials or installs and includes explicit guardrails for identity and payment actions.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (agentic commerce, multi-chain checkout, product browsing, order tracking) align with the SKILL.md and reference docs. No environment variables, binaries, or unrelated requirements are declared — all required actions target the documented https://forthecult.store/api domain.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to call documented endpoints on the store API for discovery, checkout, and tracking. It explicitly forbids sending or inferring identity tokens unless the runtime supplies X-Moltbook-Identity and mandates explicit user confirmation for state-changing/payment actions. There are no instructions to read unrelated files, environment variables, or to call external hosts.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — nothing is written to disk or fetched at install time. This minimizes install-time risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required env vars or primary credential. Optional runtime-provided X-Moltbook-Identity is described and constrained to agent-only endpoints. No unrelated secrets or host-specific credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (no forced inclusion). Model invocation is enabled (default) so an agent could act autonomously; the skill includes guardrails requiring explicit user confirmation for payments. Recommend ensuring your agent runtime enforces confirmation prompts before creating or paying orders.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for autonomous shopping on forthecult.store and purposely avoids requesting credentials. Before installing or enabling autonomous invocation, confirm that your agent/runtime will always ask the user to confirm any state-changing or payment action (create order, send crypto). Verify the domain (https://forthecult.store) in any payment instructions and double-check payment address and amount before sending funds. If you don't want agents to place orders without review, disable autonomous invocation for this skill or require explicit user confirmation policies in your agent runtime. If you need higher assurance, test with low-value orders first and monitor network calls from the runtime.
